pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or adding to losing positions; pyramiding is only authorized after a minimum +$10.00 floating profit with trailing stops locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry execution permitted within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic data releases and without multi-timeframe order book imbalance confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00, trail remainder dynamically to capture +$15.00 to +$30.00+ runs.
